adds.title: Marriage Equality Act - Amendment to Civil and Commercial Code
adds.summary: The 2 July-6 August 2020 draft to amend Books 1, 5 and 6 of the Civil and Commercial Code would allow same-sex as well as different-sex couples to lawfully engage at age 17 as 'engager'/'engaged person' and marry at age 18 (earlier with court permission for reasonable cause), replacing 'man/woman' with 'person' and 'husband/wife' with 'spouse' to extend identical spousal rights and duties on cohabitation, maintenance, property, debts, contracts, divorce, compensation, guardianship, adoption and spousal inheritance to same-sex spouses.
